name: Femto Mega I
summary: Femto Mega I is an industrial IP65 time-of-flight depth and RGB camera combining Microsoft depth technology and NVIDIA Jetson processing. It streams processed data over industrial Ethernet with PoE and supports synchronized multi-camera robotics integration through the Orbbec ROS 2 wrapper. End of marketing is scheduled for December 30, 2026.

sources.quote:
EOL Announcement for Femto Mega I
Dear customers:
In order to better assist you in addressing market changes and the challenges of
technological innovation, Orbbec Optical has provided the key lifecycle milestone
points for the Femto Mega I . We hope this information will serve as a reference for your
future product planning and development.
Orbbec Inc.
June 10,2026
Milestone Date Remark
EOL announcement 2026-06-10 EOL publicity date
EOM 2026-12-30
End of Marketing. The EOM date is the date
when the product stops accepting orders,
including orders for new sites and capacity
expansion. After that date, the product will no
longer be sold.
EOS 2028-12-30
End of Service & Support. It refers to the last
date of the service. After the EOS date, Orbbec
does not provide any service for the product.
Including software and hardware problem
support and update.
Replacement product
End of Life product Replacement product
Femto Mega I Gemini 435Le/Gemini 335Le
